### Quick “manual” way to view recent certs for *reddit.com*

Even before you hit your custom API, here’s a quick reference you can run locally or paste into a browser console:

```bash
curl -s "https://crt.sh/?q=%25.reddit%2Ecom&output=json"
```

This will return a list of Certificate Transparency logs containing domains matching `*.reddit.com`. You can then filter or parse the output as needed.
